mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 4.0% signals economic weakness that triggers central bank rate cuts, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where UNRATE exceeds 4.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous acceleration in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) above their 3-month moving average growth thresholds indicates robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where both HOUST and RSAFS exceed their growth thresholds, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a deceleration in industrial production growth (INDPRO) below 0.5% quarterly growth signals an impending supply-side slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods during late-cycle expansion when INDPRO growth falls below 0.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong residential construction activity and consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where HOUST shows a sustained upward trend, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the CPI inflation rate above 3.5% year-over-year signals persistent inflation that may lead to aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5% YoY, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous strong employment growth (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicates labor market mismatch and economic instability, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where PAYEMS growth exceeds 0.5% MoM and UNRATE rises by more than 0.2% MoM, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a deceleration in quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) below 1.5% annualized signals an impending economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods during late-cycle expansion when GDPC1 growth falls below 1.5% annualized, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.
